scene.ko: 언어 교환 친구의 문자에 일주일 동안 답하지 못해서, 이유를 설명하고 사과한다.

lines.en: Jake, I'm really sorry I didn't answer your messages last week.
lines.ko: 제이크 씨, 지난주에 문자에 답을 못 해서 정말 미안해요.
alt: Jake, sorry for not replying to your texts last week.
I'm so sorry I never got back to you last week, Jake.

lines.en: Oh, that's okay. I was a little worried, though. Is everything all right?
lines.ko: 아, 괜찮아요. 그래도 좀 걱정했어요. 별일 없죠?

lines.en: Yeah, everything's fine. I was moving to a new apartment, and it was crazier than I expected.
lines.ko: 네, 다 괜찮아요. 새 집으로 이사했는데, 생각보다 정신이 없었어요.
alt: Yes, I'm fine. I moved to a new place, and it was way more hectic than I thought.

lines.en: Oh, wow. Moving is the worst. Are you all settled in now?
lines.ko: 와, 이사는 진짜 힘들죠. 이제 정리는 다 됐어요?

lines.en: Almost. There are still boxes everywhere, but at least I have Wi-Fi now.
lines.ko: 거의요. 아직 여기저기 상자가 있지만, 그래도 와이파이는 돼요.
alt: Mostly. I still have boxes all over the place, but at least the internet works.

lines.en: Ha, that's the most important part!
Exactly. Anyway, I should have let you know. Are we still on for Thursday?
lines.ko: 그러니까요. 아무튼 미리 말했어야 했는데. 목요일 약속은 그대로죠?
alt: Right? Anyway, I should've told you. Is Thursday still okay?
I know! I should have texted you sooner. Are we still meeting on Thursday?

expressions.note: 비교급을 넣음 · crazier, harder, more hectic
settle in = 새 곳에 자리 잡다

expressions.en: I should have let you know.

expressions.note: 정해 둔 약속을 다시 확인할 때
